_comment: Per-example overrides for fingerprint tolerance and accepted-status, and the optional journal checks (lines hpo_run.log must contain; see compare_fingerprint.py). Defaults in generate_fingerprint.py: best_loss abs=1e-6 rel=1e-3; component abs=1e-6 rel=5e-3; hyperparam abs=1e-3 rel=1e-3; evals_tol=0. Override only when justified.

01_minimal.tolerance_rationale: Best loss, components and RCUT2B are pinned at the default tolerances. The evaluation count is not deterministic across machines: the optimum is on the clamped bound RCUT2B = 6.0 (eval 7), and whether DLIB:BFGS's line search accepts a re-evaluation there depends on the sign of a ~1e-13 relative, rounding-level drift of the warm-started lattice relaxation. The run ends after 12 evaluations on the reference machine (2026-10-07, 3 repeated runs identical; 16 before each finite-difference gradient took the loss at its point as its centre instead of evaluating the point again); it ran to MAXEVAL = 30 with the energies without entropy, as example 05 does. evals_tol 18 accepts 0..30: it was 14 (2..30 around 16) and was raised only to keep MAXEVAL = 30 accepted around 12. Both endings are accepted: DLIB:BFGS's objective-delta test, "DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached" (FTOL_ABS is 1e-7 by default), and MAXEVAL, "DLIB:BFGS: MAXEVAL reached" (both ended COMPLETED until every HPO driver recorded why it ended, 2026-10-07).

05_extra_observables.tolerance_rationale: Best loss, components and RCUT2B are pinned at the default tolerances. The evaluation count is not deterministic across machines: the optimum is on the clamped bound RCUT2B = 6.0 (eval 7), and whether DLIB:BFGS's line search accepts a re-evaluation there depends on the sign of a ~1e-13 relative, rounding-level drift of the warm-started lattice relaxation. The run goes on to MAXEVAL = 30 on the reference machine (2026-10-07, 3 repeated runs identical) or stops after 12 (as example 01 does with the same search; 16 before each finite-difference gradient took the loss at its point as its centre instead of evaluating the point again), and a 1-ulp change of the hot_a0 start or of one training energy flips it. evals_tol 18 accepts 12..30 (MAXEVAL is 30): it was 14 (16..30) and was raised only to keep the shorter path, now 12 evaluations, accepted. Both endings are accepted: MAXEVAL, "DLIB:BFGS: MAXEVAL reached", and the shorter path's objective-delta test, "DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached" (FTOL_ABS is 1e-7 by default; both ended COMPLETED until every HPO driver recorded why it ended, 2026-10-07).

06_init_random.description: INIT { STRATEGY RANDOM, SEED, INCLUDE_CONFIG false }.

09_init_warm.description: INIT { STRATEGY WARM } from a bootstrapped seed_pot.tadah.
09_init_warm.tolerance_rationale: Best loss, components and RCUT2B are pinned at the default tolerances. The WARM start is on the clamped bound RCUT2B = 6.0, and whether DLIB:BFGS's line search accepts a re-evaluation there depends on rounding-level noise, as in example 01 (evaluations.note), so evals_tol 30 accepts both of its endings: MAXEVAL = 30, "DLIB:BFGS: MAXEVAL reached" (the reference machine, 2026-10-07), and the objective-delta test after the second gradient, "DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached" (a scratch build with other compiler flags, 6 evaluations; FTOL_ABS is 1e-7 by default). Both ended COMPLETED until every HPO driver recorded why it ended, 2026-10-07.

12_prestage.description: STRATEGY PRESTAGE; NLOPT:GN_CRS2_LM explore + DLIB:BFGS refine.

status_accepted: STOPPED -- stagnation: no new best in 3 evals after 2 restart(s)
13_restart.tolerance_rationale: RESTART RANDOM seeds each restart from std::random_device, so the restart evaluations differ from run to run. Only values that do not depend on them are pinned: the best comes from the deterministic first launch, and each restart stops after exactly AFTER_STAGNATION evaluations because no start in the box beats the incumbent (see evaluations.note).

15_simulated_annealing.description: TADAH:ANNEAL classic with seed-local auto-T0 calibration (post T_HOT rename).

16_fixweight_mixed.description: NLOPT:LN_BOBYQA over a flat OPTIM FIXWEIGHT(14); mixed LS-fit + pinned + OPTIM'd weights.
16_fixweight_mixed.tolerance_rationale: Weight 14 multiplies a descriptor that is zero on this dataset, so the loss does not depend on it: every evaluation ties up to ~2e-13 relative, the rounding-level noise of the warm-started lattice relaxation (exact Ecoh.in read-back), and that noise decides which evaluation is the best (any weight LN_BOBYQA probes: -22.99, eval 6, on the reference machine with the free energy and the Cauchy stress in the HPO data, 2026-10-01; +25 before) and when LN_BOBYQA stops: runs to MAXEVAL = 30 on the reference machine with exact neighbour lists (2026-09-30; 3 repeated runs identical; roundoff-limited after 15 evaluations after the sheared cells of common/data/elastic.tadahdb were corrected, 30 before that). That count and status are pinned; another machine's rounding can move them, and the fingerprint must then be regenerated there with that reason. The loss and components are pinned at the default tolerances; FIXWEIGHT[14] is checked only for presence: abs_tol 100 (the box width) accepts any value in its box [-50, 50].

22_pc_observable.description: PC_OBSERVABLE cohesive_energy; DLIB:BFGS with GRAD_STRATEGY resolved to ANALYTICAL; no LAMMPS.

23_per_dataset_targets.description: PC_ERMSE (1) / (2): per-dataset targets and weights over a local config.val.

24_optim_auto.description: Example 03 with OPTIM SGRIDMB (1) AUTO, which resolves to 03's box [0.1, 0.4]: same results as 03.

25_failprobe_grading.description: FAILSCORE_GRADING ON + PC_FAILPROBE over example 02's seeded search; a lattice window grades 6 failures (band A).

journal.what: all six in band A (hot-var out of range)

26_pc_isolation.description: Example 01 with PC_ISOLATION PROCESS and PC_WORKER_TIMEOUT: 01's results in either isolation mode.
26_pc_isolation.tolerance_rationale: Example 01's search in worker processes, with 01's tolerances: best loss, components and RCUT2B at the defaults, and the evaluation count within evals_tol 18 (0..30 around 12; 14 around 16 before each finite-difference gradient took the loss at its point as its centre), for the reason given in 01's tolerance_rationale (the count at the clamped bound RCUT2B = 6.0 depends on rounding-level noise), and 01's two statuses, "DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached" and "DLIB:BFGS: MAXEVAL reached".

journal.regex: PC_ISOLATION: PROCESS -- pc_lammps tasks execute in \d+ persistent worker processes

27_dm_ream_embf0.description: NLOPT:LN_SBPLX over the two negative DM_REAM embedding knots of a tadah refit seed (EMBF0 ZERO); run.sh asserts Eiso == 0 exactly for every evaluated candidate.
